person.name: Sébastien Videment
person.text: Sébastien **founded Meritis in 2007** and is **Founder & Chairman** (signature: Président directeur général). He opened the capital to employees (about **40% of staff are shareholders**, Le Journal des Entreprises) and brought in Société Générale Capital Partenaires in a 2022 transaction. He said Meritis needed to pass the **€100M** revenue mark. Since **April 2026** Romain Danielou is Group Managing Director, freeing Sébastien for strategy. His tone on Sep 16 was polite but closed.

company.text: Meritis is a French IT consulting firm (ESN) founded in **2007**, focused on **finance, IT and regulatory** consulting, with regional agencies in France. External growth started with **Navigacom** (Dec 2024; ~40 people, ~€10M revenue; cloud, workplace, networks, cybersecurity, IoT), then **Neofin Advisory** in London (2025; ~20 consultants on regulation and risk for financial institutions). It opened **Brussels** in 2025 (3 business developers) and **Lisbon** in 2023 (17 consultants, plan to double). It aims to grow international activity **by 2027**. Executive team: Sébastien Videment (Founder & Chairman), Romain Danielou (Group MD), Cyrille Deliry (CFO), Eric Varache (HR), Julien Foulquier (Solutions).

financials.text: Revenue **€98M in 2025**, **900+ employees** (Le Monde Informatique, Apr 2026). Olivier's analysis: growth slowed from **+19.3% to +3.2%**, while the French ESN market fell **-1.8%** and recovers only **+1.4%** (sources **to be confirmed**). Société Générale Capital Partenaires invested in Dec 2022. MERITIS INTERNATIONAL: debt-funded, 0 employees (Olivier's analysis, **to be confirmed** in filings).

history.text: Sébastien wrote first on **May 26, 2026** (to oattia@gmail.com); several exchanges followed in early June; Olivier booked a call for **Sep 16, 2026, 08:30 ET**. Box moved to Scheduled **Aug 5**. On **Sep 16** Sébastien **declined**: he will come back if he sees a need. Olivier replied the same day with four points (slowing growth, dormant MERITIS INTERNATIONAL, Neofin regulatory edge vs. US state AI laws, new MD frees his time). On **Oct 18** Olivier sent the new-website email; Sébastien opened it (Oct 18) but did not reply. Total sent-email views: **11**, so he reads.
